name: Goldenwest & Warner
demographics: Goldenwest & Warner serves the Huntington Beach community, attracting middle to upper-middle income families and professionals typical of Orange County's coastal areas. The trade area draws from surrounding residential neighborhoods with a mix of young families, established homeowners, and retirees who value convenience shopping. Visitors tend to be local residents seeking everyday services and necessities within a short drive from home, with shopping patterns focused on quick trips rather than destination retail experiences.
description: Goldenwest & Warner is a neighborhood shopping center conveniently located at the intersection of Goldenwest Street and Warner Avenue in Huntington Beach, California. This community-oriented retail destination serves the local residential population with a practical mix of everyday services and conveniences. The center's strategic location in Orange County's desirable coastal region provides easy access for residents seeking quick shopping trips and essential services. With a solid 4.4-star rating from nearly 800 reviews, the property has established itself as a reliable neighborhood retail hub. The center maintains convenient operating hours from 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM, accommodating the busy schedules of Huntington Beach residents and visitors alike.
